head.viewportNote:
interactive-widget=resizes-content makes a phone keyboard shrink the LAYOUT
     viewport, not just the visual one, so the chat sheet (position: fixed) sits
     flush on the keyboard instead of leaving a strip of page showing under the
     composer. The three game pages already carry it; the hub did not, which is
     why the gap only ever showed here.
head.stylesNote:
The rest of this page's CSS is inline, for a landing page's first paint.
     Two exceptions, both shared with the games and both worth the same-origin
     request: the design tokens, which have to be one file to stay in step
     (#128), and chat, whose rules every page needs identically.

pages.//catalogue: This page's app fetches a word catalogue at runtime (shared/words/<lang>.js) instead of importing one statically, so that a Spanish player downloads Spanish words and not both. A dynamic import only starts once app.js is executing, one round trip later than the static import it replaced, so head.njk preloads the right catalogue and the fetch starts at HTML parse instead. Drop this flag and the page still works, just slower.
pages.//categories: This page offers the word catalogue's categories, so the build checks that every id in WORD_CATEGORIES has category.<id>.name and .desc in this locale's runtime table. A missing one is invisible at runtime: catName() falls back to the raw English id, which reads as correct in English and as a bug in Spanish.

Same check as the word page: every id in WORD_CATEGORIES needs category.<id>.name and .desc in this locale. Draw only OFFERS four of the seven (see DRAWABLE in its app.js), but the check covers all seven and the runtime block carries all seven, so that widening DRAWABLE is a one-line change and never a silently untranslated row.

head.titleNote:
Title leads with "Imposter" deliberately. Nearly every real search query
     uses that spelling, and /dance/ and /word/ both lead with it too. The
     brand name, og:title, schema and all body copy stay "Impostor".

pages.//categories: This page offers the SONG catalogue's categories, so the build checks that every id in songCategoryIds(<this locale>) has category.<id>.name and .desc in this locale, plus a heading for each of that language's groups. Per locale since #165: each language offers its own list of pools, so asking for another language's would demand strings this bundle has no reason to carry. Same check word and draw get, different catalogue: dance shares no words with them.

//games: No href here on purpose. A game's page path is derived per locale from pages[].locales, because a stored href can only ever be one language's and would put an English path on a Spanish page (#158). See gameHref() in scripts/build.mjs.
